- HARDENING_SUGGESTION
  File: tests/test_update_workflows_manifest_verify.py
  Location: behavioural test section (after test_clean_release_verifies, near other @needs_tools behavioural tests)
  Issue: The LAST RUN DIFF adds `WORK="$(mktemp -d)" || reject input workdir_unavailable` as a defensive guard against temp-directory creation failure, but no behavioural test exercises that reject path. The existing tests only cover content-driven rejections (asset_missing, attestation_failed, hash_mismatch, unlisted_path, verifier_hash_mismatch, verifier_unattested, manifest_header_mismatch, release_tag_missing). A regression in the new guard (e.g., removing the `|| reject ...` clause) would not be caught.
  Suggested minimal fix: add a test that points TMPDIR at a path where `mktemp -d` cannot succeed (e.g., a non-writable directory or a non-directory path) and asserts: (1) result.returncode != 0, (2) the stdout contains `::error::UPDATER_MANIFEST_VERIFY outcome=rejected reason=workdir_unavailable`, (3) outputs["verified"] == "false", (4) outputs["reason"] == "workdir_unavailable", (5) the reason file is written with the standard ERR_RELEASE_MANIFEST_VERIFY_FAILED header. The existing `_run` helper already forwards `TMPDIR=str(tmp_path)`, so the test only needs to pre-create a file at `tmp_path/mktemp_blocker` and point TMPDIR at it (or use a per-test subdir with mode 0o555 on a writable parent).
  Estimated lines changed: ~25
  HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
- HARDENING_SUGGESTION
  File: .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml
  Location: Verify attested release manifest step, tag discovery awk script (lines 178-190 in PR diff)
  Issue: The tag discovery `awk` script resolves the release tag for UPSTREAM_SHA by selecting the highest `vX.Y.Z` tag whose peeled commit equals UPSTREAM_SHA. When two or more semver tags point at the same commit (e.g., `v1.2.3` and `v1.2.3-hotfix1` are both annotated at the same commit), the strict `^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$` filter would pick `v1.2.3`, but the script does not verify that the asset URL actually matches UPSTREAM_SHA — it only verifies the manifest header (`.release_sha == UPSTREAM_SHA`) and the per-file hash. Two parallel tags pointing at the same commit yield the same manifest (same tree, same files), so the hash check still binds to UPSTREAM_SHA; this is safe by construction but the connection is not obvious. A short comment clarifying that same-commit multiple tags produce identical manifests (so tag selection cannot bypass the hash check) would help future maintainers.
  Suggested minimal fix: append one comment line after the awk pipe explaining why same-commit multi-tag ambiguity cannot escape the per-file hash check. Example: `# Multiple tags at the same commit produce identical manifests; tag selection cannot affect the hash check below.`
  HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
  Estimated lines changed: 1
